documentation.title: LangChain v1 migration guide
documentation.excerpt: Use langchain.agents.create_agent for new agents. The older langgraph.prebuilt.create_react_agent helper is deprecated.

documentation.title: LangGraph persistence
documentation.excerpt: A checkpointer saves graph state at each super-step. Invocations that should share state must use the same configurable thread_id.

documentation.title: LangGraph interrupts
documentation.excerpt: Interrupts pause graph execution and persist state. Resume the same thread by invoking the graph with Command(resume=value).

github_issue.title: Graph resumes from the beginning when thread ID changes
github_issue.excerpt: Resolved by reusing the original thread_id when sending Command(resume=...). A new thread starts a separate checkpoint history.

github_issue.title: Import error after upgrading to LangChain v1
github_issue.excerpt: Legacy agent APIs moved to langchain-classic. New agent implementations should import create_agent from langchain.agents.

release_note.title: LangChain and LangGraph v1
release_note.excerpt: LangChain v1 introduces create_agent as the standard agent API. It runs on LangGraph and supports middleware, persistence, streaming, and human-in-the-loop.

release_note.title: LangGraph v1
release_note.excerpt: LangGraph v1 keeps the core StateGraph and runtime APIs stable while deprecating the prebuilt create_react_agent helper.
